# Tauri Build — production builds, signing and distribution for Tauri v2

Curated by Skill Harbor — @full-stack-skills' tauri-build: a Tauri v2 agent skill for production builds, signing and distribution. Trigger phrases (build, release, signing, distribution, pipeline, plus Chinese equivalents) route the agent to a workflow: identify target platforms and packaging formats, configure the release build and signing requirements, produce per-platform installers or app bundles, validate release artifacts and update channels. Ships with a curated reference list to the official Tauri v2 docs (llms.txt, per-format distribute pages, per-platform signing guides, CrabNebula Cloud and GitHub CI pipelines).
